blade.doc: katana, plasma sword, electro baton: one closed claw (owner pick combat-notes-1 A), a low guard ahead of the gun-side hip, the blade leaving the claw in line with the forearm and turned wrist_rad in toward the centre line, tip forward; the off arm free. Held the same aimed or not (no rifle carry across the chest).

chainsaw.doc: the chainsaw at the hip in both claws, the off claw on the top handle (fore_u along the body)

heavy.doc: the Gatling and the flamer wand braced at the hip in both claws, the off claw forward on the barrel housing; a heavier walk

long_gun.doc: rifles, the shard caster, the plasma and electro guns, the ray gun: stock at the gun shoulder, the off claw under the barrel at fore_u; carried across the chest when not aiming

sidearm.doc: pistol, machine pistol, hand cannon, Gloria: one claw, low ready at the hip, aimed with the claw arm only

thrown.doc: one bottle in the claw; the wind-up and throw are RigGrip's thrown kind

tube.doc: the rocket launcher and the mini nuke on the gun shoulder, the claw pulled in, the off claw on the front grip

doc: d7-held: Rivet's hold per weapon class, the hold built into his body. Per class: the RigGrip kind, its weapons, the gun claw's place (gun_reach = share of the arm's reach along the weapon line, across = where that line starts, as a share of the way out to the gun shoulder, hand_z = part px, below 0 toward the hip), the off claw's (off_reach, 0 = free arm), the claw cell, the anchors (the gun claw closes on weapon_art's grip_px; fore_u = the off claw's place as a share of the weapon's length, -1 = none), wrist_rad (a blade's turn off the forearm, in toward the centre line) and the walk/aim modifiers (stride_k scales the stride, lean_px leans the body back, part px, against a heavy weapon's weight; both read by RigGrip.walk while the weapon is out; view only). Every rivet_arsenal.json weapon is in exactly one class.
